evt.xsd_invalid: XML does not conform to the AEAT schema, so it was not transmitted: {validation_error}
evt.transmission_retry: AEAT transmission failed ({environment}) after {attempts} attempt(s); retrying in {backoff_minutes} min
evt.not_transmitted: Not transmitted to the AEAT after {attempts} attempt(s): {error}
evt.diagnostic_ran: VeriFactu test run against {environment} with sample invoice {sample_number}
evt.diagnostic_certificate_invalid: VeriFactu test against {environment}: the certificate is not valid — {cert_message}
evt.diagnostic_gateway_unavailable: VeriFactu test against {environment}: ERPlora cannot file for you right now — {cert_message}
evt.diagnostic_issuer_nif_missing: VeriFactu test against {environment}: the taxpayer (issuer) tax ID is missing — set it in Settings → Business before testing the connection
evt.diagnostic_sample_record_invalid: VeriFactu test against {environment}: your configuration does not produce a valid test record — {cert_message}
evt.chain_validated: Fingerprint chain intact: {total} record(s) with their SHA-256 chaining verified ({issuer_nif}). Amounts are not re-audited
evt.chain_recovered_from_aeat: Chain recovered from the AEAT for {issuer_nif}: continues at sequence {sequence_number} of {found} record(s) found
evt.chain_continued_manually: Chain continued manually for {issuer_nif}: continues at sequence {sequence_number}

reason.certificate_unavailable: the certificate file could not be loaded: check in Settings → Business that it is uploaded and that its password is correct
reason.no_transmission_route: this hub has no way to file yet: it has neither a certificate of its own nor a connection to ERPlora's fiscal gateway
reason.gateway_not_ready: ERPlora's fiscal gateway cannot file right now ({detail})
reason.gateway_not_ready_unspecified: ERPlora's fiscal gateway cannot file right now and did not say why
reason.gateway_unreachable: ERPlora's fiscal gateway could not be reached; try again in a few minutes
reason.producer_facts_missing: this hub has not received its software-producer details from ERPlora yet; they arrive on their own the next time it syncs
reason.sample_envelope_invalid: the test record could not be built from this hub's settings
reason.gateway_ready: ERPlora's fiscal gateway is available and files on your behalf
reason.issuer_nif_missing: set the taxpayer (issuer) tax ID in Settings → Business before testing the connection
reason.sample_record_schema_invalid: the AEAT schema refused the test record: {detail}
reason.schema_envelope_empty: the record to be filed came out empty; it is not valid XML
reason.schema_envelope_not_regfactu: the envelope is not a VeriFactu filing (RegFactuSistemaFacturacion)
reason.schema_record_missing: the envelope carries no invoice record at all
reason.schema_header_issuer_missing: the filing carries no taxpayer: set your business tax details in Settings → Business
reason.schema_issuer_identity_incomplete: your business tax details are incomplete: {element} is required and came in empty
reason.schema_representative_incomplete: the filing agent's details are incomplete: {element} is required
reason.schema_element_out_of_order: {element} is filed out of order; the AEAT schema expects {sequence}
reason.schema_element_missing: {element} is required and is not in the record
reason.schema_element_missing_or_empty: {element} is required and is either missing or empty
reason.schema_element_empty: {element} is required and came in empty
reason.schema_value_not_in_enum: {element} is «{value}», which the AEAT schema does not admit; it only takes {allowed}
reason.schema_value_too_long: {element} is «{value}», longer than the {max} characters the AEAT admits
reason.schema_recipient_block_required: a {invoice_type} invoice has to identify the customer; a sale with no customer tax ID is a simplified F2 receipt
reason.schema_hash_type_unsupported: the hash type «{value}» is not supported; the AEAT only takes 01 (SHA-256)
reason.schema_hash_malformed: the record hash is not a valid SHA-256 (64 hexadecimal characters)
reason.aeat_tls_rejected: the AEAT did not accept the certificate when opening the secure channel; check that it has not expired and has not been revoked
reason.aeat_unreachable: the AEAT could not be reached; try again in a few minutes
reason.schema_rectification_field_on_plain_invo: a {invoice_type} invoice rectifies nothing, so it cannot carry {element}; the AEAT only admits it with invoice type {allowed}
reason.schema_rectification_type_missing: a {invoice_type} corrective invoice requires TipoRectificativa ({allowed}); without it the AEAT refuses the record, which has already spent its chain number
reason.schema_rectification_amount_required: a corrective invoice by substitution (TipoRectificativa=S) requires ImporteRectificacion with the corrected base and tax
reason.schema_rectification_amount_not_allowed: a corrective invoice by difference (TipoRectificativa=I) already declares the delta in its own amounts; ImporteRectificacion is only filed with TipoRectificativa=S
reason.schema_breakdown_empty: the breakdown carries no DetalleDesglose line: the AEAT does not admit an empty breakdown
reason.schema_breakdown_too_many_lines: the breakdown carries {count} lines and the schema admits {max}
reason.schema_breakdown_value_not_in_enum: breakdown line {line}: {element} is «{value}», which is not in the enumeration; it only takes {allowed}
reason.schema_breakdown_regime_not_in_enum: breakdown line {line}: ClaveRegimen «{value}» is not in the AEAT L8A/L8B lists
reason.schema_breakdown_regime_not_allowed: breakdown line {line}: ClaveRegimen is only admitted with tax {allowed}, and this line declares {tax}
reason.schema_breakdown_regime_required: breakdown line {line}: ClaveRegimen is required with tax {tax}; without it the AEAT answers error 1245
reason.schema_breakdown_regime_requires_n2: breakdown line {line}: ClaveRegimen {regime} requires CalificacionOperacion N2 and carries «{qualification}»
reason.schema_breakdown_qualification_conflict: breakdown line {line}: CalificacionOperacion and OperacionExenta are a schema choice — one or the other, never both
reason.schema_breakdown_qualification_missing: breakdown line {line}: CalificacionOperacion or OperacionExenta is missing; the schema requires one of the two
reason.schema_breakdown_exemption_igic_only: breakdown line {line}: OperacionExenta «{value}» only exists with tax 03 (IGIC); under VAT the list is E1–E6
reason.schema_breakdown_exempt_amount_not_allow: breakdown line {line}: a line with OperacionExenta cannot carry {element}
reason.schema_breakdown_untaxed_amount_not_allo: breakdown line {line}: with CalificacionOperacion «{qualification}» the line cannot carry {element}; it is the AEAT's error 1237
reason.schema_breakdown_reverse_charge_not_zero: breakdown line {line}: under reverse charge (S2) {element} has to be 0 and is {value}
reason.schema_breakdown_reverse_charge_missing: breakdown line {line}: under reverse charge (S2) {element} is required and goes to 0 — it is not left out
reason.schema_breakdown_vat_rate_not_allowed: breakdown line {line}: TipoImpositivo {value} is not a VAT rate; the AEAT only admits 0, 2, 4, 5, 7.5, 10 and 21
reason.schema_breakdown_surcharge_rate_not_allo: breakdown line {line}: TipoRecargoEquivalencia {value} is not an equivalence surcharge rate; the AEAT admits 0, 0.26, 0.5, 0.62, 1, 1.4, 1.75 and 5.2
reason.schema_simplified_over_ceiling: a simplified F2 invoice cannot go over {ceiling} € (plus {tolerance} € of tolerance) adding base and tax of every line, and this one adds {total} €; at this amount a full invoice identifying the customer is required
reason.earlier_records_pending: an earlier record of the same chain has to go first, because records reach the AEAT in order

evt.transmission_deferred: Not sent to the AEAT yet: {why}

ui.recordsSearchPlaceholder: Search invoice, issuer or tax ID…
ui.recordsEmptyNoInvoices: No invoices issued yet. Every invoice you issue is sealed and listed here.
ui.recordsNotSealing: This hub has issued {count} invoice(s) and has 0 VeriFactu records. They are not reaching the AEAT, and by law they have to.
ui.recordsSealingUnknown: There are no records, and the number of issued invoices could not be read, so it is not possible to tell whether the chain is sealing. Ask an administrator to check it.
ui.errCancelRequiredRecord: Cannot discard: the record has not been registered with the AEAT yet. Retry the transmission instead.
ui.errGoLiveIsOneWay: Cannot switch back to test mode: this hub already sent an accepted record to the AEAT in production. To try things out, use another hub (a free one or the demo).
ui.goLiveHint: Your invoices are going to the AEAT's test environment. When everything is ready, go live: ERPlora checks that nothing is missing first.
ui.goLiveConfirmTitle: Send your invoices to the AEAT for real?
ui.goLiveConfirmMessage: From now on every invoice is filed with the real AEAT. You can go back to testing only until the first invoice is filed.
ui.goLiveDone: Your hub is live: invoices are now filed with the real AEAT.
ui.goLiveDemoHint: This is a demo hub: it always files with the AEAT's test environment. Create your own hub to go live.
ui.goLiveOneWayHint: Your hub has already filed invoices with the real AEAT, so it cannot go back to testing. To try things out, use another hub.
ui.standDownHint: No invoice has been filed with the real AEAT yet, so you can still go back to testing.
ui.standDownConfirmTitle: Go back to the test environment?
ui.standDownConfirmMessage: Invoices will go to the AEAT's test environment again, and will not count before the tax authority.
ui.standDownDone: Your hub is back in the test environment.
ui.errGoLive: Could not go live. Try again in a moment.
ui.errGoLiveNeedsGrant: To go live, ERPlora needs your signed authorisation to file on your behalf, approved by our team. Sign it in Configuration.
ui.errGoLiveNotReady: Your hub is not ready to go live yet: it needs your business tax details and a way to file (your own certificate or ERPlora's). Check Configuration.
ui.errGoLiveDemo: This is a demo hub and cannot go live. Create your own hub to file for real.
ui.errGoLiveCertificateExpired: Your own certificate has expired and the AEAT does not accept it. Upload a renewed one, or let ERPlora file for you, and try again.
ui.errGoLiveClosed: This hub ceased activity and does not issue invoices any more.
ui.testHint: Validates the certificate and sends a TEST record to the AEAT. Does not affect the real chain or your invoices.
ui.testInvoiceCreated: Test invoice created — view it in Invoicing.
ui.testInvoiceTestingOnly: Only available in the testing environment and with the issuer tax ID configured.
ui.certExpiryHint: Extracted automatically from the certificate when you save it.
ui.certExpired: The certificate has expired. Renew it to send to the AEAT.
ui.testNoRun: No test run yet. Save the certificate and press “Send test”.
ui.testQrNote: Scan to validate the invoice at the AEAT
ui.testAeatNotSentDelegated: Nothing was filed, and on this route that is correct: a filed record cannot be undone, so ERPlora checks the route instead of using it.
ui.producerInfo: Software manufacturer details, fixed and declared to the AEAT on every record.
ui.obligadoHint: Business issuing the invoices. The AEAT validates it; it must match the certificate holder.
ui.obligadoFromHub: Taken from the business fiscal identity in Settings → Business. It is the hub's single source, so it is shown here and changed there.
ui.certHubHint: The fiscal certificate is configured in Settings → Business (it's a hub resource, not this module's).
ui.routeUnknownHint: This hub does not publish the filing route yet. Update the hub to see it here; meanwhile the screen only reports whether a certificate of your own is loaded.
ui.routeOwnHint: You sign and file with your own certificate; no authorisation to ERPlora is needed.
ui.routeDelegatedHint: ERPlora files your invoicing records with the tax authority on your behalf, with its own certificate. Your signed authorisation is what allows it.
ui.grantHint: It is signed in Settings → Business, where ERPlora prepares the official form and a person reviews it. Only an approved authorisation lets your business go live.
ui.certOptionalHint: On this route you do not need a certificate of your own: ERPlora files with its own. Upload one only if you would rather file directly.
ui.testNeedsGatewayIdentity: Connect this hub with ERPlora above to run the live test.
ui.testGatewayNotReady: ERPlora cannot file for you right now
ui.testNeedsOwnCertificate: Upload the business certificate in Settings → Business to run the live test.
ui.gatewayHint: So that ERPlora can file with the tax authority on your behalf, this hub and ERPlora identify each other with a certificate of this device. The private key is created here and never leaves it.
ui.gwUnknownHint: We could not ask this hub about its connection. Reload the screen; if it keeps happening, the hub is not answering.
ui.gwAbsentHint: Request it and ERPlora prepares it. A person at ERPlora reviews and signs it, usually within 24-72 hours.
ui.gwPendingHint: Already requested. A person at ERPlora still has to sign it, usually within 24-72 hours; the hub collects it on its own as soon as they do.
ui.gwExpiringHint: Renew it before it expires: while it is expired, ERPlora cannot file on your behalf.
ui.gwExpiredHint: ERPlora cannot file on your behalf until you renew it. In the meantime your records wait in the contingency queue.
ui.gwFiled: Requested. A person at ERPlora reviews and signs it, usually within 24-72 hours.
ui.gwAwaitingReview: It was already requested and is still under review. Nothing else to do here.
ui.gwInstalled: Connection active. ERPlora can now file on your behalf.
ui.gwOutOfBudget: Too many checks in one hour. The hub keeps trying on its own; come back in a few minutes.
ui.gwOutcomeUnknown: ERPlora answered something this screen cannot read. Report it to support.
ui.gwErrNoMachineCredential: This hub has not finished connecting to ERPlora, so it cannot request anything yet. Try again in a few minutes.
ui.gwErrCsrUnavailable: This hub could not prepare the request. Report it to support.
ui.gwErrCloudUnreachable: We could not reach ERPlora. The hub keeps trying on its own; try again in a few minutes.
ui.gwErrNotInstallable: ERPlora signed the connection but this hub could not install it. Report it to support with the code below.
ui.gwErrRefused: ERPlora refused the request. The code below says why.
ui.gwErrNotAdmin: Only an administrator of the hub can request this connection.
ui.gwErrHttp: The hub did not answer the request. Try again in a moment.
ui.capabilityHint: VeriFactu signs and sends with the business certificate, and the hub only lends it to a module the owner has allowed. It is granted once in Settings → Permissions, and it starts OFF in any hub whose modules were not installed through the Apps consent dialog (a blueprint, the API or an import).
ui.enabledNeedsPermission: VeriFactu is on. For it to sign and send, the «Business certificate (fiscal signing)» permission has to be granted in Settings → Permissions.
ui.errCapabilityDenied: VeriFactu is not allowed to sign: the «Business certificate (fiscal signing)» permission is not granted. Grant it in Settings → Permissions and try again.
ui.recChainScope: This recomputes the SHA-256 fingerprints and verifies the chaining. It does not re-audit the amounts: the base, quota and total are checked before a record is sealed, and once chained they are immutable.
ui.recManualHint: Paste the last hash (64 hex) from your previous application to continue the same chain.
ui.recConfirmAeatMessage: Local continuity will be rebuilt from the latest record available at AEAT. Verify the issuer tax ID before continuing.
ui.recConfirmManualTitle: Continue the chain from an external hash
ui.recConfirmManualMessage: The supplied hash will become the predecessor of the next fiscal record. Use this only during a migration and after verifying the source data.
ui.recErrHash: The hash must be 64 hexadecimal characters
ui.errIssuerRequired: VeriFactu cannot be enabled without a taxpayer: set the tax ID and company name in Settings → Business first.
ui.errDemoEnvironmentLocked: This is a demo hub: it always files to the AEAT test environment, so it cannot be switched to production. Everything else works — records are chained, and each one gets its ticket and its QR. To invoice for real, create your own hub.
ui.errDemoCertificateLocked: This is a demo hub: it cannot hold its own business certificate, because the AEAT issues no fictitious one. ERPlora files your records with the tax authority on your behalf, always against the test environment. To use your own, create your own hub.
ui.errDemoIdentityLocked: This is a demo hub: its tax ID and company name are fixed and cannot be edited, because the documents it issues are nobody's. To invoice under your own tax ID, create your own hub.
ui.errTestInvoice: Could not create the test invoice
ui.pendingWhenNextSend: It goes out on its own at the next automatic send — every 5 minutes, as soon as this hub can file — in order and declared to the AEAT as a late submission. You don't need to do anything.
ui.pendingWhenQueued: It is in the contingency queue and goes out on its own at its next attempt, {at}, in order and declared to the AEAT as a late submission. You don't need to do anything.
ui.pendingWhyUnknown: It did not go out when it was created.
ui.pendingWhyUnavailable: The reason could not be loaded.
ui.declDesc: The declaration ERPlora signs for the version of the system you are running, and the identifying data every invoice sends to the tax authority. This is the screen you show if you are ever asked for them.
ui.declPending: ERPlora's identifying data has not arrived yet. It arrives on its own within a minute of the system being up; until then no invoice can be sent to the tax authority.
ui.declError: Could not load the responsible declaration.
ui.cfgOwnOffHint: ERPlora files your invoicing records with the tax authority on your behalf, with its own certificate. You do not need one.
ui.cfgOwnOnHint: You file directly with the tax authority using your business certificate. It never leaves this hub.
ui.cfgOwnOffKeptHint: Your certificate is still stored on this hub, but ERPlora now files on your behalf with its own certificate. Switch it on to use yours again.
ui.routeSwitchedOwn: Done: from now on you file with your own certificate.
ui.routeSwitchedDelegated: Done: from now on ERPlora files on your behalf. Your certificate is still stored.
ui.errRouteNeedsGrant: For ERPlora to file in production, your representation grant still has to be approved. Until then you keep filing with your certificate.
ui.errRouteNeedsConnection: For ERPlora to file, this hub’s secure connection still has to be signed. Until then you keep filing with your certificate.
ui.errRouteNeedsCertificate: There is no certificate uploaded: upload it in Configuration to use it.
ui.errRouteSwitch: The filing route could not be changed. Nothing changed; please try again.
ui.cfgP12Hint: The file and its password are kept by the hub and never travel to this screen again.
ui.cfgP12Error: The certificate could not be saved. Check the file and the password.
ui.cfgP12Denied: This app is not authorised to use the business certificate. Grant it in Settings → Permissions.
ui.cfgP12Removed: Certificate removed. ERPlora files on your behalf again.
ui.cfgRemoveHint: Turning this off deletes the certificate from this hub and goes back to ERPlora filing on your behalf. You can upload it again later.
ui.cfgDelegatedHint: Your signed authorisation is what allows it. Without it, the business cannot go to production.
ui.cfgGrantHint: You download the official model already filled in with your details, sign it outside this screen and upload it back. A person at ERPlora reviews it.
ui.grantDownloaded: Model downloaded. Sign it and upload it below.
ui.grantBusinessMissingHint: The official model is filled in with the tax ID, legal name and fiscal address from Settings → Business. Complete them there so the signed model matches your invoices.
ui.dropErrorType: “{name}” is not an accepted file type.

grant.intro: ERPlora files your invoicing records with the tax authority ON YOUR BEHALF. Spanish law needs your signed consent for that: the official form of the colaboración social agreement. You download it, sign it away from this screen, and upload it back.
grant.stateVigente: Approved on {date}. ERPlora may file on your behalf.
grant.statePendiente: Uploaded on {date}. We are checking it and will email you within 24-72 hours.
grant.stateRejected: Sent back on {date}. Fix what is noted below and upload it again.
grant.stateRevoked: Revoked on {date}. ERPlora cannot file on your behalf.
grant.stateAbsent: Not signed yet. Your business cannot go live until it is.
grant.stateUnreachable: We could not reach ERPlora, so we cannot tell you where this stands.
grant.step1Hint: We fill it in with your details. Its wording is set by the tax authority and cannot be changed.
grant.step2Hint: A person at ERPlora checks it and emails you within 24-72 hours.
grant.signerNif: ID number of the person signing
grant.signerName: Full name of the person signing
grant.howToByHand: By hand: print it, sign it, stamp it with the company seal if your business is a company, and scan it back to PDF.
grant.howToElectronic: Electronically: sign the PDF with AutoFirma using your own qualified certificate. A drawn signature is not accepted.
grant.privacyController: Controller: ERPLORA CLOUD SL (B27593136). We hold these documents as your representative.
grant.privacyPurpose: Purpose and basis: to file your invoicing records with the Spanish tax authority on your behalf, under the grant you sign and our legal duties. We keep them while the grant lasts and for the tax retention periods.
grant.dniChoose: Attach a copy of the ID
grant.signatureSampleWhy: A NIE often carries no printed signature, so we need a sheet with your handwritten signature to compare it against.
grant.representationProofWhy: Your business is a company, so we need the document that names the person allowed to sign for it.
grant.preferComputer: I would rather do this from my computer
grant.partyLegalRepresentativeHint: The person who signs on behalf of the company, as named in its deeds. Their ID copy is the one uploaded below.
grant.privacyRights: Your rights: access, rectification, erasure, objection and portability at privacy@erplora.com.

errors.obligado_nif_required: Your business needs a taxpayer ID before you can do this.
errors.signer_required: Fill in the name and ID number of the person signing.
errors.document_type_invalid: Pick the kind of identity document.
errors.signed_document_not_pdf: The signed form has to be a PDF — scan it or sign it with AutoFirma.
errors.dni_copy_required: Attach a copy of the identity document.
errors.signature_sample_required: With a NIE we also need a sample of your handwritten signature.
errors.representation_proof_required: Attach the document that proves you may sign for the company.
errors.document_too_large: Each file has to be under 10 MB.
errors.invalid_via: That route is not one we can file through.
errors.cloud_rejected: ERPlora could not handle this right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.hub_not_enrolled: This hub is not connected to ERPlora yet.
errors.identity_not_shared: We could not tell ERPlora who the taxpayer is. If the page asks for your tax details, save them again in Settings → Business.
errors.open_external_failed: We could not open your browser.
errors.unknown: It did not work. Try again.

grant.resendHintPending: If something came out wrong, send it again: the new submission replaces the one under review.
grant.resendHintInForce: While we review the new submission, you keep filing with the current one.
